The run-daily function emitted zero DECISION or NO TRADE log lines over the last 8 hours. This fires on any full trading day where the function reached no decision — caused by: (1) Scheduler not dispatching, (2) function crashing before the decision stage, or (3) the GCS lock being held for the whole day. Per-asset exceptions that return HTTP 200 do NOT suppress this alert because they still emit a decision summary line.

To investigate: check Cloud Scheduler job history, then Cloud Logging for `run_daily failed` or lock-held messages.
